Just an update from myself as I have tried to help with this issue, I have not seen this problem at all on my Mac Studio M1 Max with any Godot version.  I am using an Apple Keyboard and mouse and single Apple Studio display.  There are a number of reports logged with Apple and other sites about Logitech mice having lag issues with MacOS Sequoia 15.x.  Both of the users I've tried to assist in the thread are using Logitech MX Master series mice.  I am not saying this is the cause, nor that the user's machines are at fault, but clearly investigation is necessary.  Both users have also tried directly connected USB mice and the issue remained.

I always use the Forward + renderer with the Metal backend, but my quick testing with Mobile and compatibility mode did not show the problem.

My system is extremely lean with NO additional software other than XCODE and Godot.  I have no additional extensions or plugins of any kind.  I also don't use, and have disabled, Siri and Apple intelligence as well as Spotlight.  Nor do I have any external USB devices connected, both my external drives use Thunderbolt.

Another thought which I haven't tested could this in someway be related to the USB device bug that appears occasionally until certain USB devices are removed and reattached?  I have not asked the users to test this nor do I know if this issue has ever been seen on MacOS.

I'm also unable to reproduce on macOS 15.3 using Magic Mouse 2 or MBP builtin trackpad, even with vsync disabled and "update continuously" off.

I completly remove LogiOption+ from my Mac and the problem is still here.

I try a new project and set Mode Vsync : OFF & Update continuously : ON and the **pb was still here !**
I switched to Compatibility Mode and the pb disappeared...

**In fact :** 
Forward+ or Mobile => the pb occurs **with** or **without** the workaround.
Compatibility mode => the pb disappears **ONLY** with the workaround.

I have this issue as well.

macOS 15.3.2 (24D81)
Godot: 4.4. (I can also verify that I have the issue in 4.4.stable, 4.3-beta1 but it's **not** present in 4.3-dev6).

Built in trackpad always works flawlessly.

I have the issue both with my wireless Logitech mouse **and** with my wired Razor mouse.
I have the issue with and without Logitech Options+.
I have the issue with and without other periphials connected to my computer.

I don't have any text selection/input lag etc. issues in any other program. And regarding what @VirtuallyRetro said, I have never had any issues with my Logitech mice/keyboards before or now.

No settings tweaking solves it for me, but setting Mode Vsync : OFF & Update continuously : ON make the issue less noticable. I'm just missing about 1 character on selections instead of about 6 characters. The wired mouse also has the same effect i.e. the problem still persists but with fewer characters missed.

HI everyone,  It might be useful for those with the issue to try logging onto their machines as a new user, which should eliminate any installed extensions or apps used currently, just to see if the problem is related to something in the user account.

This was something we always asked when trouble shooting these sorts of issues, sorry I didn't think about it before now..

Ryn

HI, I just did a test with all the different revisions of the Apple Magic Mouse. Though I wasn't able to reproduce the issue exactly, I did notice that the earliest version with the earlier firmware did perform more sluggishly when selecting text within Godot. This early version also randomly disconnects from modern Mac machines and is not listed as compatible with Apple Silicon based based machines. Firmware versions are below, latest to oldest. Hope this helps any. The low RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indicator) listed on the early version is probably the main problem. Lower generally equate to poor performance. Ryn

Some questions for anyone who can reproduce this:

- Can you reproduce this issue in other code editors such as Visual Studio Code?
- Can you reproduce this issue after setting **V-Sync Mode** to **Disabled** in the Editor Settings, then restarting the editor?
- Can you reproduce this issue after enabling **Single Window Mode** in the Editor Settings, then restarting the editor?
- Can you reproduce this issue after enabling **Update Continuously** in the Editor Settings?

I don't have access to affected hardware to reproduce this on my end.

Thank you Calinou for taking care of this case...

Can you reproduce this issue in other code editors such as Visual Studio Code? 👉 NO
Can you reproduce this issue after setting V-Sync Mode to Disabled in the Editor Settings, then restarting the editor? 👉 YES
Can you reproduce this issue after enabling Single Window Mode in the Editor Settings, then restarting the editor? 👉 YES
Can you reproduce this issue after enabling Update Continuously in the Editor Settings? 👉 YES

The only way not to reproduce this issue is  to **set at the same time setting** V-Sync Mode to Disabled & Update Continuously to Activated & compatibility mode to Compatibility (not work with Forward + and Mobile)

To answer Calinou's questions:
> Can you reproduce this issue in other code editors such as Visual Studio Code?

No. The text selection in VS Code (my code/text editor), Safari, and Outlook works correctly. (I recognize two out of three of those aren't code editors, but they are applications where you can select text, at least.)

> Can you reproduce this issue after setting V-Sync Mode to Disabled in the Editor Settings, then restarting the editor?

V-Sync mode is apparently already set to Disabled in the Editor Settings.

> Can you reproduce this issue after enabling Single Window Mode in the Editor Settings, then restarting the editor?

Yes, the issue persists with Single Window Mode set to Enabled.

> Can you reproduce this issue after enabling Update Continuously in the Editor Settings?

No. With Update Continuously set to Enabled, text selection and window dragging is correct. (Sounds like this lines up with other peoples' experiences of disabling V-Sync, enabling Update Continuously, and running a project in Compatibility mode.)

I can reproduce this error as well. Macbook Pro M3 Pro. Running Godot 4.4.1 and using a Logitech MX Master 3S.

I've felt for a while that the interface felt sluggish and I was having the odd delay in selecting text. I run Godot as an LSP server for Sublime Text, which has remained fast, responsive and smooth the whole time.

Disabling V-Sync and enabling Update Continuously has fixed the issue and Godot feels very smooth again. The only downside is that my Mac's fans kick in after a while, since Godot is obviously using a lot more resources this way.

I'm not running the Logitech Options+ software, I severely dislike it. I do use USB Overdrive to map my mouse buttons. With or without Overdrive makes no difference to the lagging issue and its temporary fix.

I'm also experiencing this on my M1 MacBook. I don't use the built-in Godot code editor, but there seems to be a fraction-of-a-second delay between a click and Godot registering it as an input. This causes a stutter-like feeling in my mouse-controlled game.

The issue only occurs with external mice; I've tried Bluetooth, dongle-based, and wired models. It's not reproducible with the Mac's built-in trackpad or in any other applications. I also tested the same setup on Windows and Linux, and they all work fine. The problem still occurred even after I tried it on a fresh macOS user account with default configurations.

I've tried a few things in the project settings as well. Disabling V-Sync and enabling “Update Continuously” didn't help. I attempted to switch to the Compatibility renderer, but that broke my project, so I wasn't able to see if it made a difference.

Just adding that this is still happening on the Godot 4.5 release. The mouse doesn't matter it happens with the track pad too, only in Godot. Xcode, VSCode, Arudino IDE, and normal document editor software are all unaffected.

EDIT: Based on the thread linked above, I disabled Magnet (which is a window snapping software I was running) and it fixed the laggy code selection AND it fixed the unresponsive window (whenever you click off of it and click back on it).  So weird, I've used Magnet for years and have had zero issues with it using any other app. 

Credit to @mertkasar for finding this! Thanks so much!

Huge shout out to @SNelson81! Quiting Magnet solved all lag issues in Godot. Both the text selection issue as well as the hang on regaining focus. Default settings now active for Godot (for VSync and Continuous update) and in Forward+ mode: zero lag. Indeed strange as I also have been using Magnet for a few year without issues. Luckily MacOS has some window snapping build in these days, so less need for Magnet. 

This is potentially also why for some people booting in safe mode solved the issue as then auto starts of apps aren't done (and Magnet thus doesn't load)...

Something with a conflict in the propagation of events from the mouse between Magnet and Godot?

For completeness: running Godot 4.5 Stable. But issues was there from Godot 4.2 to Godot 4.5. Running MacOS 26 on M2 Pro 16GB and have the Logitech MX Master S3 for Mac.

Thanks a lot @SNelson81, quitting Magnet solve the problem ! 👍🎉 If you use magnet, no need to close it, just set "ignore Godot" in the dropdown menu : Make the focus on Godot and then open the dropdown and clic on "ignore Godot", et voila, no more issues ! I’ll play with Godot a bit to see if it’s completely gone before closing the issue.

Truly, I considered going back to Windows...the web based version of Godot worked better than my local install. After a day of testing, leaving it open for hours without touching Godot is still as snappy as you'd hope.

I was thinking it could be an issue with macOS window-tiling apps in general, so I tried out Rectangle Pro which I happened to have on my computer as well, and it seems like Godot works *relatively* fine with it? Perhaps it's a bit slower than no window-tiling app at all, but definitely better than Magnet at the moment.

macOS's built in window tiling is taking a bit of getting used to, but I'm finding it works well enough for my use cases, until the issue with Magnet is resolved, and I don't feel any slowdown when using it.

Crazy! This works for me as well. I wonder what caused this behavior...

If I get some extra time on my hands I kind of want to git bisect what change in godot made Magnet interact with Godot in this way only with bluetooth accessories.

I started going through and testing different stable versions of Godot to see if I could bisect the issue. Unfortunately, I'm finding it persists all the way back to 4.0 stable, which I'm thinking might mean that it has to do with a particular change in *Magnet* itself. Currently I'm on Magnet 3.0.7; I'll have to see if there's a way to get and test prior versions and validate (or debunk) this hypothesis.
Consolidating in #104246 since this seems caused by the thirdparty Magnet application.
